_comment: All dimensions in mm. Rim shape is an irregular quadrilateral: A=bottom-left, B=bottom-right, C=top-right, D=top-left.

vertices._comment: Inner edge of the rim (the edge the adapter sits against).

_ab_bulge: Inward curvature (sagitta) of the A-B edge. 0 = straight.
_wall: Wall thickness, added outward from the inner rim edge.

profile_test._thickness: Extrusion height (Z) of the flat test piece.

faceplate._wall_height: Height of the walls that wrap down over the rim.

port_hole._comment: Cutout through the cap for dust to pass. Vertices define its outline on the cap face.
